About This Portfolio

My internship at EFB,
documented

This portfolio documents my journey as a Business Intelligence Intern at the Egyptian Food Bank (EFB), one of Egypt's largest hunger-relief organizations serving millions of beneficiaries across the country.

Throughout this internship, I worked on transforming raw operational and business data into meaningful insights by building Power BI dashboards, Power Apps solutions, and automation workflows that support decision-making and improve efficiency.

The goal of this portfolio is to showcase not only the projects I developed, but also the business impact created through data and automation.

As a BI Intern, I work at the intersection of data engineering, visual analytics, and low-code application development — helping EFB make smarter, faster decisions at scale.

My work spans the full BI stack: from querying 10+ normalized SQL Server tables to building executive-level Power BI dashboards, designing Power Apps for field operations, and automating workflows with Power Automate.

Every dashboard I built helps program managers monitor voucher utilization across 27 governorates, track food distribution to 80K+ families, and identify inefficiencies that free up resources for more beneficiaries.

Freemart Performance Dashboard

My Journey

What I worked on
during this internship

During this internship, I had the opportunity to work on real business problems at scale. Here is an overview of everything I was involved in and the skills I applied and developed along the way.

📊
Building Interactive Power BI Dashboards
  • Designed executive dashboards processing 1M+ records/month tracking 900K+ beneficiaries across Egypt's regions
  • Built dual Dark/Light theme toggle with optimized Star Schema for sub-30-second data refreshes
  • Created financial analytics dashboards covering 145K+ transactional records across 3+ years
🧠
Data Modeling & Advanced DAX
  • Engineered 15+ optimized DAX measures for voucher utilization rates and regional performance benchmarks
  • Implemented 35+ KPIs including YoY Growth, MoM Growth, Gross Margin %, and Rolling Averages
  • Designed normalized Star Schema data models connecting multiple fact and dimension tables
📱
Creating Power Apps Applications
  • Developed a full-featured digital POS system supporting 10+ menu items with dynamic pricing logic
  • Built real-time order calculation engine with automatic invoice generation for field staff
  • Integrated the app with SharePoint backend for live transactional data and multi-user access
⚡
Designing Automated Workflows (Power Automate)
  • Built end-to-end cloud flows triggered on order completion to auto-dispatch digital receipts via email
  • Reduced invoice turnaround time by 80% and eliminated manual data entry for staff
  • Connected SharePoint order lists to automated notification pipelines for real-time updates
🗄️
Working with SharePoint-Based Systems
  • Architected a scalable SharePoint backend to manage live transactional data and order history
  • Designed audit log structures supporting concurrent multi-user access without data conflicts
  • Connected SharePoint lists directly to Power Apps forms and Power Automate flows
AI Tools

Throughout this internship I leveraged AI assistants as productivity tools — learning to write effective, goal-oriented prompts to speed up research, generate code scaffolds, debug DAX formulas, and produce cleaner documentation.

Claude AI
Used for structured content generation, technical explanations, brainstorming ideas, summarizing documentation, and improving written reports and business-related content.
Google Gemini
Used for research support, data exploration, idea generation, information gathering, and obtaining alternative approaches for analytical tasks and problem-solving.
ChatGPT
Used for coding assistance, SQL and Python support, debugging, DAX and Power BI guidance, automation ideas, documentation, and accelerating daily workflow tasks.
Prompt Engineering
— I learned to craft clear, specific prompts that include context, constraints, and expected output format. This skill significantly improved the quality of AI-generated results and reduced back-and-forth, making AI tools genuine productivity multipliers rather than just search engines.
